title: Donor Portal Route Metadata & Feature Gating Consistency

1_safe_404_responses.mechanism: src/app/portal/layout.tsx, src/app/login/page.tsx, and src/app/register/page.tsx invoke if (!isDonorPortalEnabled()) { notFound(); }

2_header_footer_isolation.mechanism: Header.tsx and Footer.tsx wrap all portal and donor links in {isDonorPortalEnabled() && (...)}

4_sitemap_exclusion.mechanism: src/app/sitemap.ts explicitly registers 22 canonical public routes + 3 SSG stories; zero portal routes included

5_route_metadata_registry_reconciliation.mechanism: src/lib/routes.ts updated: LOGIN, REGISTER, and PORTAL_DASHBOARD set to inNav: false, inFooter: false, inSitemap: false, priority: 0.0, status: 'planned'

6_env_default_safety.mechanism: isDonorPortalEnabled() requires explicit string 'true'; defaults to false when env is undefined or empty

7_backend_api_protection.mechanism: Spring Boot SecurityConfig mandates JWT Bearer authentication on protected donor endpoints independently of frontend visibility
